profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Indeed
profile.summary:
Accomplished Java software engineer with 10+ years of experience. Implemented several projects including API web services, batch job, socket services, web applications, desktop applications and android applications. Solid understanding of data structures and algorithms.
I got two Java SE 8 certificates from Oracle:
- Oracle Certified Associate, Java SE 8 Programmer (June-19-2018)
- Oracle Certified Professional, Java SE 8 Programmer (July-30-2018)
I got one Kubernetes certificate from Cloud Native Computing Foundation
- CNCF Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (August-31-2020)

Languages: Java 8/17, Python, Javascript, C++
Backend: Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data, Spring Cloud, Hibernate, JDBC 
Databases: MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, PostgreSQL, H2, Oracle
Big Data: Spark, Scala, Spring Batch, Hive, BigQuery
Front End: JSP, Thymeleaf, jQuery, Data visualization D3.js, Google chart API
Responsive Web Design: HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap
Testing: JUnit, Selenium
Web Services: Restful, Microservices, SOAP
Web Application Servers: Apache Tomcat 7, Glassfish 4.1, Nginx
Cloud Technologies: AWS, Azure
Design Patterns: Singleton, Factory, Prototype, Abstract Factory, MVC, MVVM
SDLC: Waterfall, Agile/Scrum
Tools: IntelliJ IDEA, Eclipse, Git, Jenkins, SVN, Maven, Gradle, Postman, Visual Studio Code, JIRA
Operating System: Mac OS, Window 7/10, Linux (Ubuntu, CentOS 7)

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description: Developed batch job as well as RESTful API to carry out the company's business including cashback digitalization, credit application, and operational automation platform for Walmart's next-gen point of sale.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Batch Processing · React.js · Apache Kafka · Google BigQuery · Kubernetes

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.locationName: Quang Trung Software Park, Ho Chi Minh city, Vietnam
positions.description: I was a Java software engineer. I used Spring MVC, RestTemplate, Hibernate, Postgres, MongoDB, Cloud Foundry, Work Flow Engine to implement RESTfull web services to support and create servers in the enterprise cloud environment such as AWS, Soracom, ECL 2, Cloud Foundry.

positions.title: Research Assistant - Software Engineer
positions.description: I implemented cryptography algorithms such as lightweight block cipher, hash then applied them into IoT applications including web applications, TCP/UDP, Android application. I also implemented a real-time front-end interface for a machine learning project and NFC smartcard-based, smartphone-based, smartwatch-based as a deterministic factor for smart mirror authentication. I also implemented the Socket IO, RESTful API as an authentication and authorization service.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: I worked as software engineer for a start-up company, made desktop applications for accounting firms and television companies in Vietnam. I used C# WindowForm, DevExpress, TFS, MySQL, Entity, Linq, MVC.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description: I was a software engineer in CSC Vietnam. I specialize in C#, Java, Cobol.

positions.title: Intern
positions.locationName: Quang Trung Software Park, Ho Chi Minh, Vietnam
positions.description: I worked as a part-time intern. It is a mandatory part of the undergraduate program in the Ho Chi Minh City University of Technology. I worked on the project about image compare using C++.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Information Security and Internet of Things
